signalJourney.title: Six stations, one light pulse.
signalJourney.subtitle: From the distribution point to the wall socket — every step planned, measured and documented.

steps.title: Signal origin
steps.description: The light pulse leaves the Point of Presence (PoP) and enters the fiber route.

steps.title: The route
steps.description: Cable laid via micro-trenching (NE3) or air-blowing along the planned route.

steps.title: The fusion
steps.description: Precision arc fusion joins two fiber ends with minimal loss — measured and logged immediately.

steps.title: The penetration
steps.description: Controlled, sealed building entry via the access point for line technology (APL).

steps.title: The last mile
steps.description: In-house riser cabling (NE4) distributes the signal to every unit in the building.

steps.title: The activation
steps.description: TA/OTO socket installation and final OTDR certification complete the route.
